parse_suncg_house: parse a SunCG house JSON file to extract rooms and objects with bounding boxes and attributes
get_nearby_pairs: find pairs of objects that are spatially close using horizontal and vertical distance thresholds
get_closest_distance: compute the closest corner-to-corner distance between two objects along specified axes
get_all_pairwise_distances: compute and sort all pairwise distances between a list of objects by proximity
find_closest_points: find the closest accessible point on a navigation map for given coordinates using a spatial tree
